# Query reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-api/api/queries.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`ew query [<project-dir>] <name> <key> [--explain] [--json]` answers one public query of the project as a reader: it takes no lock and writes nothing. `--explain` adds the memo policy, the dependencies and the provenance; `--json` prints the object `ew.query-result/1` whose `output` is the query's output below. This reference lists the 12 queries of the registry, from the snapshot [`crates/ew-api/api/queries.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/crates/ew-api/api/queries.json), which `ew queries --json` prints. A key uses the reference grammar of command logs (`tag:`, `id:`, `folio:`); `-` stands for no key. The examples run on the golden project ([doc 17 §3.4](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#34-examples-on-the-golden-project)).

| Query | Key | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`bom_rows`](#bom_rows) | `-` | The bill of materials in the parts mode that folio 901 prints: position, quantity, part, manufacturer, description, tags and folios of each row. |
| [`cell_of`](#cell_of) | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a device)` | The folio and frame cell of a device's main representation. |
| [`channel_addresses`](#channel_addresses) | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a PLC module)` | The address of each channel of a PLC module, in channel-number order. |
| [`device_tag`](#device_tag) | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a device)` | A device's full designation and its tag as displayed on its main page. |
| [`displayed_tag`](#displayed_tag) | `<device>,folio:<label> (a device and a page)` | A device's tag as a page prints it: the structure the page shares is left out. |
| [`page_order`](#page_order) | `-` | The folio labels of every page in page order: drawn pages, section dividers and generated report pages. |
| [`plc_address_text`](#plc_address_text) | `id:<uuid> (a function) \| tag:<tag> (a device: its main function)` | The PLC addresses a function's representation prints beside it. |
| [`potential_name`](#potential_name) | `id:<uuid> (a wire or a junction) \| tag:<tag> (a terminal)` | The name of the potential a wire, a junction or a terminal belongs to, with its aliases. |
| [`title_block`](#title_block) | `folio:<label> (a drawn page)` | The values a drawn page's title block prints, by binding path. |
| [`wire_numbers`](#wire_numbers) | `folio:<label> (a drawn page)` | The numbers of the wires numbered on a drawn page (their From end lies on it), in numbering order. |
| [`wire_props_of`](#wire_props_of) | `id:<uuid> (a wire)` | The cross-section and colour of each physical wire of a connection, each with where it comes from. |
| [`xref_text_of`](#xref_text_of) | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a device)` | The cross-reference text printed at a device's main representation. |

## `bom_rows`

The bill of materials in the parts mode that folio 901 prints: position, quantity, part, manufacturer, description, tags and folios of each row.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `-` |
| Example | `ew query bom_rows -` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | array of [`BomRowOut`](#bomrowout) | yes |  | The rows in order. |

### BomRowOut

One row of `BomRowsOutput`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | yes |  | The description. |
| `folios` | array of string | yes |  | The folios. |
| `manufacturer` | string | yes |  | The manufacturer's name. |
| `part_number` | string | yes |  | The part number. |
| `position` | string | yes |  | The position (`1`; `A1` for a configured product). |
| `quantity` | string | yes |  | The quantity. |
| `tags` | array of string | yes |  | The devices' tags. |

## `cell_of`

The folio and frame cell of a device's main representation.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a device)` |
| Example | `ew query cell_of tag:-101F1` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cell` | string or `null` | no |  | The frame cell of its anchor, row then column (`B8`); `null` outside the frame grid or unplaced. |
| `folio` | string or `null` | no |  | The folio of the main representation's page; `null` for a device that is not placed. |

## `channel_addresses`

The address of each channel of a PLC module, in channel-number order.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a PLC module)` |
| Example | `ew query channel_addresses tag:-201U5` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channels` | array of [`ChannelAddress`](#channeladdress) | yes |  | The channels in number order. |

### ChannelAddress

One channel of `ChannelAddressesOutput`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | yes |  | The address as drawings print it (`Q0.1`), `TBD`, `excluded` or `unresolved`. |
| `number` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The channel number. |

## `device_tag`

A device's full designation and its tag as displayed on its main page.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a device)` |
| Example | `ew query device_tag tag:-101F1` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `displayed` | string | yes |  | The tag as displayed on the device's main page (`-101F1`), else its short tag. |
| `full` | string | yes |  | The full designation (`=P01+J-E-2416-101F1`). |

## `displayed_tag`

A device's tag as a page prints it: the structure the page shares is left out.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `<device>,folio:<label> (a device and a page)` |
| Example | `ew query displayed_tag tag:-101F1,folio:101` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `displayed` | string | yes |  | The tag as the page prints it. |

## `page_order`

The folio labels of every page in page order: drawn pages, section dividers and generated report pages.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `-` |
| Example | `ew query page_order -` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `folios` | array of string | yes |  | The folio labels in page order. |

## `plc_address_text`

The PLC addresses a function's representation prints beside it.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `id:<uuid> (a function) \| tag:<tag> (a device: its main function)` |
| Example | `ew query plc_address_text tag:-201U3-Q1` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string or `null` | no |  | The text a `PlcAddress` slot prints (`Q0.1`, `I0.0 / I0.1`); `null` when no address resolves. |

## `potential_name`

The name of the potential a wire, a junction or a terminal belongs to, with its aliases.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `id:<uuid> (a wire or a junction) \| tag:<tag> (a terminal)` |
| Example | `ew query potential_name id:5945bf6c-b3b1-5964-8651-59a4b48396d3` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aliases` | array of string | yes |  | The other names its definitions give it. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The name (`?` for a potential without one). |

## `title_block`

The values a drawn page's title block prints, by binding path.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `folio:<label> (a drawn page)` |
| Example | `ew query title_block folio:101` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | map of string | yes |  | Binding path (`page.title`) → printed text; a path without a value is absent, an image prints `(image)`. |

## `wire_numbers`

The numbers of the wires numbered on a drawn page (their From end lies on it), in numbering order.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `folio:<label> (a drawn page)` |
| Example | `ew query wire_numbers folio:102` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `numbers` | array of string | yes |  | The printed numbers in numbering order. |

## `wire_props_of`

The cross-section and colour of each physical wire of a connection, each with where it comes from.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `id:<uuid> (a wire)` |
| Example | `ew query wire_props_of id:13c75a2c-b8f2-5b51-8e22-4cb6522139b0` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `potential` | string | yes |  | The potential's name. |
| `wires` | array of [`WireOut`](#wireout) | yes |  | The physical wires the connection belongs to, in the order of their numbers. |

### WireOut

One physical wire of `WirePropsOutput`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `colour` | [`WireProp`](#wireprop) or `null` | no |  | The colour; `null` when no level gives one. |
| `cross_section` | [`WireProp`](#wireprop) or `null` | no |  | The cross-section; `null` when no level gives one. |
| `number` | string | yes |  | The printed wire number (`?` when unnumbered). |

### WireProp

One effective property of a wire with where it comes from.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | string | yes |  | The value as text (`1.5`, `BU`). |
| `via` | string | yes |  | Where it comes from, as the property grid's chip names it. |

## `xref_text_of`

The cross-reference text printed at a device's main representation.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Key | `tag:<tag> \| id:<uuid> (a device)` |
| Example | `ew query xref_text_of tag:-201U1` |
| Output version | 1 |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  | The printed cross-reference; empty when the representation has none. |
